title: Oily Light Romantic Brazilian Gelatin Stir-fry
description: This light and romantic dish is perfect for a warm evening in Brazil. Fresh gelatin, stir-fried with love and care, creates a harmonious balance of flavors.
instructions: Rinse 12 scallop shells in cold water and set aside.
Mix 2 tablespoons of unflavored gelatin with 2 tablespoons of cold water in a small bowl and let it sit for 5 minutes.
Heat 1 tablespoon of coconut oil in a skillet over medium heat.
Add 1 cup of mixed wild berries to the skillet and stir-fry for 3 minutes, allowing their natural sweetness to shine through.
